explanation: Stays at 0-1 at every step until about trial 85; in the last ~12 trials it switches on, with GO staying low (0-3) and D2 climbing over the trials to 3-8 (10 when an a2 choice ends in a rare S1). In those late trials D1 is usually 8-10 when the agent is about to choose a2 or the previous trial was unrewarded, but 0-1 after a rewarded trial when the agent keeps choosing a1.
